title: Codebase AI
description: Queries any public GitHub repository in natural language and returns cited, source-grounded answers. Retrieval is a hybrid of cosine similarity and AST-based Python symbol lookup. No RAG framework was used and every retrieval change was validated with a controlled A/B evaluation across 100+ live runs before being kept.

title: AI Enhanced Recipe Platform
description: A full-stack recipe platform built with performance and scalability in mind, combining server-side rendering, AI-generated images, and intelligent recipe enhancements to deliver a fast and visually rich user experience.

title: DevFlow - Developer Collaboration Platform
description: A real-time collaboration platform for developers with integrated code editor, video calls, and project management. Built from scratch with modern technologies and used by 5,000+ developers worldwide.
